lines.1: After all that playing around, evening was here before we knew it.
lines.4: 「I guess that's how much fun I had today.」
lines.6: 「I had fun too. And I learned a lot about what you're into.」
lines.7: 「If you had that much fun, I guess I've repaid my debt.」
lines.9: 「...Or so I was about to say.」
lines.12: 「It's not enough, so... pay me back with another day like today.」
lines.14: 「I mean, let's keep hanging out. That's... what I mean.」
lines.16: That was her roundabout, girlish way of saying she wanted to hang out some more.
lines.17: And then there was the way Konoe looked up at me.
lines.18: That was just unfair... If she did that, then I...
lines.20: 「I've repaid the whole debt! That should be enough.」
lines.22: 「No, no. I don't want our relationship to be about a debt anymore!」
lines.24: 「The notebook doesn't matter! I just want you to go on dates with me!」
lines.28: 「I thought saying it straight was the manly thing to do.」
lines.29: 「When I looked at you, the words just came out.」
lines.30: 「Oh...? You sure about that? You're just getting carried away by the moment, aren't you?」
lines.31: 「Didn't you think about what would happen if I turned you down? Like you always do?」
lines.32: 「I did. But I wanted to say it even more.」
lines.33: 「Even if you said no, that wouldn't be a reason to give up.」
lines.34: 「It's all in how you look at it.」
lines.38: She thumped me on the shoulder again and again.
lines.39: 「Charging ahead like that suits you better, Tsushima. You've always held that side of yourself back.」
lines.40: 「...I finally got to see that side of you.」
lines.43: 「Konoe, what about the answer that actually matters?」
lines.52: 「But you've spent years getting on my nerves before finally acting like this, so I get to tease you a little, right?」
